scope: One disposable identity; private nonce-guarded incomplete shop draft only. No fake public profile, owner identity, policies/PDFs, model invocation or email sends.
checks: All three deployed shop routes explicitly enforce JWT
Customer receives only published profile fields
Customer cannot change shared shop settings
Saving a shop draft leaves customer profile unchanged
Old customer JWT still cannot read a shop draft
Stale shared revision cannot overwrite a draft
Incomplete live shop information cannot be published
Failed publication preserves the customer snapshot
Discard removes only the synthetic draft
Shop writes record audit metadata without contact or draft content
